senses.gloss: f. (colonia) a Roman colony (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Colonia).
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 10a:14">Ab. Zar. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>ותתעביד טבריא ק׳</he> and that Tiberias be declared a Roman colony.
<cite ref="Sukkah 45a:4">Succ. 45ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="M00572"><he>מוֹצָא</he> II</cite>; Y. ib. IV, beg. 54ᵇ <cite ref="S01273"><he>קָלוֹנְיָיא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 10">Deut. R. s. 10</cite> <he>לאיסטרטיגין ששימש … פרס וקלאונה</he> (read <cite ref="T00390"><he>רומי</he></cite> for <he>פרס</he>, a corr. acc.) a general that held offices in two provinces, one a Roman province, the other a colony; (Yalk. ib. 942 <he>פרס וק׳</he>, omitted).

<cite ref="Bava Batra 4a:4-5">B. Bath. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>את הורודוס עבדא בישא מתעביד ק׳</he> Ms. R. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 70) thou, Herod, being a bad servant (of Rome), (thy country) be declared a colony (an anachronistic allusion to the reduction of Judæa to a Roman province on the banishment of Archelaus).—
<cite ref="Yevamot 115b:9">Yeb. 115ᵇ</cite> <he>בצד קלוניא מתא</he> by the side of the town of Colonia (?).
